text.desktop: Welcome to the Practice Dojo! This is a practice board with two pre-fabricated decks. Nothing you do here is saved. Leave any time with **✕** or Esc.
text.phone: Welcome to the Practice Dojo! This is a practice board with two pre-fabricated decks. Nothing you do here is saved. Leave any time with **✕**.

text.desktop: First, your opening hand. Look at a card up close: click the magnifier in its top-right corner. Click again to put it back.
text.phone: First, your opening hand. Press and hold a card to see it large. Tap anywhere on it to put it back.

text.desktop: Click a card you don't want, say the most expensive one, to send it to the bottom. The curve and inkable readout under the hand show what you'd keep. Click it again to keep it.
text.phone: Tap a card you don't want, say the most expensive one, to send it to the bottom. The readout under the hand shows what you'd keep. Tap it again to keep it.

text.desktop: Press **Mulligan** (the key counts the cards you marked): they go to the bottom of your deck, you draw as many, and the deck is shuffled. Nothing marked? The key says **Keep hand**.
text.phone: Tap **Mulligan** (the key counts the cards you marked): they go to the bottom of your deck, you draw as many, and the deck is shuffled. Nothing marked? The key says **Keep hand**.

text.desktop: Your new hand: the card you drew has a **NEW** pip. Press **Start turn** to play.
text.phone: Your new hand: the card you drew has a **NEW** pip. Tap **Start turn** to play.

steps.text: The bottom half is the player whose turn it is: the hand, the play area and the inkwell. The other player's side is at the top.

text.desktop: Put a card in your inkwell: drag it from your hand onto the inkwell, or hover it and press **INK**.
text.phone: Put a card in your inkwell: tap a card in your hand, then **Ink**.

hint.phone: Only inkable cards can be inked; the others say **No ink**.

text.desktop: Now play a card: drag a 1-cost character onto your play area, or hover it and press **PLAY**.
text.phone: Now play a card: tap a 1-cost character, then **Play**.

steps.hint: The cost is the number in the card's top-left corner.

steps.text: Hover any card on the board to read it here, full size: cost, strength, willpower, lore and text.
Tap a card in your hand to open its drawer: the card full size, and what you can do with it. Close it when you've read it.

text.desktop: Done for this turn? Press **End turn**, or the Space bar.
text.phone: Done for this turn? Tap **End turn**.

steps.text: Now you're Player 2: the board turns round, so their side is at the bottom. Settle their opening hand, then ink one of their cards.

text.desktop: Changed your mind? **Undo** takes back the last thing you did. Press it now to take that ink back.
text.phone: Changed your mind? **Undo** takes back the last thing you did. Tap it now to take that ink back.

steps.text: Every turn you end is kept as a node in the **Multiverse**. The mini map shows them here; **Multiverse** (or M) opens the whole tree.
Every turn you end is kept as a node in the **Multiverse**. This button opens the whole tree.
